errors.text_span: The effect of the main market on the price of the economy in the market.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the chart purpose as related to the effect of the main market on the price of the economy, whereas the chart represents measures to limit the 'hidden economy' in the country.
The description does not mention that the chart illustrates measures to limit the 'hidden economy' in the country.
The description does not mention the horizontal axis categories, which list various measures, nor the vertical axis, which represents percentage values.
The description does not mention the color coding of the bars (blue for values below 9% and red for values above 10%).
The description does not mention the specific percentage values associated with each measure, ranging from 2% to 13%.

The description does not mention the measures with the highest values ('Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система', 'Да се намали корупцията', 'Да се подобри качеството на административните услуги', and 'Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса').
The description does not mention the measures with the lowest values ('Да се засили граничния контрол' and 'Да се намалят акцизите' at 2%).
